generate_populated_index: generate a populated FAISS index by adding embeddings to a trained index file and writing the result
test_generate_populated_index: test the populated index generation by verifying the index file exists and has the correct number of entries
run_populate_job: run a PopulateFAISSIndexModule job via submitit executor with optional interruption to trigger checkpointing
test_population_checkpointing: test that running a populate job with and without interruption produces identical index output files
add_embedding_to_index: add embeddings from a binary file to a loaded FAISS index with specified dimensions and data type
